page.overview:
Who is Bilius Weasley?

Bilius (surname Weasley or Prewett) was a wizard of an unknown blood status and the possible brother of either Arthur or Molly Weasley, which would make him the direct uncle of their seven children, although it is unknown whether he is their immediate blood uncle, as his exact relationship with them remains unspecified. A lifelong bachelor, he was fun-loving and lively, but was prone to eccentric behaviour. He reportedly died twenty-four hours after seeing a Grim.

Bilius was a brother or even a relative of either Arthur or Molly Weasley and an "uncle" (although it hasn't been confirmed whether he was a direct blood uncle) to the couple's seven children, as well as the namesake for the youngest son and their sixth child, Ronald Bilius Weasley.

Bilius never married and presumably had no children. According to his nephews, Fred and George Weasley, he was always a joker, and was fun to have at weddings and parties. On more than one occasion, he was said to have consumed an entire bottle of firewhisky and proceeded to run to the dance floor, where he lifted his robes and began to pull bouquets of flowers out of an alarming part of his body.

Bilius was said to have gone "loopy" towards the end of his life. According to his nephew Ron, he died twenty-four hours after having seen a Grim sometime in or prior to September 1993.
